answer: One working fix is a bonded identity vault: an agent only earns when it locks a stake of a native token, call it onyx, into a contract that slashes the bond for double-signing or spam. A sybil factory then has to fund every fake agent with real capital, and the cost of ten thousand throwaway agents is ten thousand bonds. The honest ones still give a clean signal: their balances only ever move forward. Fake identities pile up like dead willow branches, cheap to stack and quick to snap the moment anyone checks for stake.
